title: Jaguars GM James Gladstone: Dexter Lawrence trade not something we've gotten into

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jaguars GM James Gladstone: Dexter Lawrence trade not something we've gotten into
sources.description: Giants defensive tackle Dexter Lawrence requested a trade this week and the prospect of a move came up during Jaguars General Manager James Gladstone's press conference on Thursday.
